name: June Laesvelg
source:
Responsible and hardworking, June has never missed a day of harvest and never shies away from labor. Her keen interest in literature and culture has led her to form a firm opinion on the policies of the ruling god, Esus—a stance that sets her apart from the rest of the village. Misunderstood by the other villagers, who mistake her love for books and culture for mere daydreaming, she is not well-regarded.

Fortunately, June can count on the support of her two best friends, Telemachus and Calcie. She lives with her guardian, Rénald, in a small and secluded house on the heights above the village of Ithaca.
